title: Step 63-C shared Cart/Checkout data, credential and authoritative state foundation
description: Implement only the shared Storefront Cart/Checkout foundation on top of canonical Step 63-B contracts: generated-OpenAPI-derived Cart/Quote/Address/Shipping/Checkout/Payment aliases, one server-only Cart/Checkout credential boundary, shared server adapters using the existing API client/customer-session bridge, and authoritative async/recovery state typing. Refactor the existing Product Detail add-to-cart server helper to reuse the shared Cart credential boundary without changing its user-visible behavior. Keep all Step-63 routes as placeholders; do not start production Cart UI, checkout identity/address/delivery/review routes, payment return/outcome UI, backend/OpenAPI/database changes, dependencies, Current State or design contracts.

dependencies.name: Backend/OpenAPI Cart/Checkout contract readiness
dependencies.evidence: PR #305 protected workflow_dispatch run 37120602080; merge job 111195793070 SUCCESS; exact-SHA postmerge 111195843966 SUCCESS; terminal Lock release comment 5968874417.

acceptance_criteria.description: Cart, quote, address, shipping, reserve/order and payment Storefront types are direct aliases of generated OpenAPI request/success contracts; no parallel authoritative DTO is created.

Guest Cart and Checkout credentials remain server-only, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax and host-only; duplicate/invalid credential cookies fail closed and raw tokens are never exposed to route data, browser state, URLs or logs.
acceptance_criteria.verification: pnpm --dir apps/storefront cart-checkout-foundation:verify && pnpm --dir apps/storefront typecheck

acceptance_criteria.description: Shared server adapters use the canonical API client and existing customer-session bridge where customer ownership applies, preserve X-Cart-Token/X-Checkout-Token and idempotency boundaries, and do not add implicit retries for unsafe mutations.
The existing Product Detail add-to-cart helper reuses the shared Cart credential boundary without changing endpoint, quantity, error mapping or visible behavior.
acceptance_criteria.verification: pnpm --dir apps/storefront cart-checkout-foundation:verify && pnpm --dir apps/storefront spec-related-cart:verify

acceptance_criteria.description: Shared state types reuse canonical AsyncSurfaceState and explicitly model backend authority plus unknown-result/status-check recovery for unsafe checkout/payment mutations; no false-success state is introduced.
All Step-63 routes remain placeholders and Stage 63-C does not start production Cart/Checkout/Payment UI or mutate backend/OpenAPI/database/dependencies/design/current-state.

Canonical completion requires exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, applicable Storefront checks, deterministic review, exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release before Stage 63-D begins.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Stage 63-C is MEDIUM risk. Direct-main write/raw merge are prohibited. Stage 63-D remains blocked until protected transport, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release are green.
